note: SP p.36, Александринскій, 17 Суббота. Heading line breaks: Общс-/ства (line break inside word, joined «Общсства» exactly as printed: first line ends «Общс-», second line begins «ства», so the printed word lacks the expected е and looks like a misprint of «Общества»); Клиниче-/скомъ (joined Клиническомъ); ушед-/шихъ (joined ушедшихъ). The two letters after «и» (expected «на») are badly faded and not legible; ‹?›‹?› means unreadable, context suggests «на». Receipts line (not read) excluded.
